summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Roleplay Stream Board. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (REST + WebSocket JOIN/WELCOME/STATE broadcast, GM auth via gmSecret, GM-only mutations, player DICE_ROLL permitted, CARD_CREATE/PATCH/DUPLICATE/DELETE, BOARD_CLEAR, LIBRARY_UPSERT/REMOVE, SCALE/DICE_TYPE/SOUND/BG set, scale clamping, user count via /room/{token}/info, 404 on unknown room, invalid-room error close). Frontend: Landing loads, GM creates room and navigates to /room/{token}?gm=1, WebSocket connects (status open), Create-Card modal works end-to-end and card renders with full stat grid (edit/dup/del/rotate/info/mode + all per-stat +/- testids), GM dice roll (Acción D6 qty=3) appears in Historial with player label and total, second-browser player join modal works (join-modal/join-name-input/join-submit), GM sees '2 USUARIOS', player menu limited to menu-dice-settings only, player Ataque D6 roll syncs in real-time to GM history. Share link dialog shows correct /room/{token} URL. Background image loads. No page errors/console errors.

minor.issue: Every CARD_PATCH (e.g., drag-move) triggers a full-state broadcast (~cards+library+history+users). Fine at small scale; could be chatty with frequent drags. Acknowledged in code comment.
No cleanup of empty rooms — long-running server keeps stale Room objects in memory. Acknowledged as optional in code.

issues: Modal-overlay continues to intercept pointer events for elements behind it while open (expected for a modal, but users need to close via 'X' or click outside before interacting with the menu — just a note, not a bug).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py looks clean: proper async/await, CORS configured from env, in-memory Room model per spec (no DB as user requested), GM-only mutation gating correct, DICE_ROLL allowed for all, history clamped to 200, scale clamped [0.4, 2.5], name truncated to 80 chars.
Frontend useRoom hook has robust reconnect logic (1.5s retry) and correct WebSocket URL derivation from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (replaces http -> ws).
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes (landing, room, main-menu items, dice-roller, create-card modal, join-modal, share-dialog, per-card actions & stats).
Landing uses axios; rest of app uses native WebSocket. Consistent with env-var usage (process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). No hardcoded URLs.
ObjectId/_id not applicable — no MongoDB used per spec.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no login. GM identity via gmSecret persisted in localStorage; players via URL + name modal.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral rooms created during tests with TEST_ prefix (in-memory only, go away on server restart).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend WebSocket tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover all action types. Uses wss://{REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host}/api/ws/{token}. Frontend flows tested via Playwright: landing → create room → create card → dice roll → 2nd-context player join → player roll sync to GM. All data-testids confirmed present. Not tested via automation (can be self-verified by main agent): Load YAML file input, individual card drag event (react-draggable), sound playback, card edit dialog submit, individual per-card foco/attack-pool click triggering rolls, wound indicator visual thresholds, aguante red warning visual. All underlying backend support for these flows is verified via broadcast tests.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Share dialog overlay intercept was a test-script sequencing artifact (didn't close dialog before clicking another menu) — not a product bug.
